title: A Face for Denim Days
caption:
A Face for Denim Days

Twenty years ago, I began my career
at a luxury beauty counter in Japan.

Heavy makeup defined the moment.
As a beauty advisor, I wore a full face every day —
three shades of foundation,
black laid beneath the eyeshadow,
smoky, high-coverage, unmistakable.

I wore that same face on my days off, too,
with denim and the simplest clothes.
A perfect face with effortless clothes
can read as luxury, when the balance is right.
With the skills I had then, it did not.

Makeup should change with what you wear.
This, more than anything, is how a look is finished.
A jacket asks for one face; denim, for another.

Treat makeup as part of the whole look.
On a slow day off,
doing a little less is exactly right.
